cards.subtitle: Deterministic Eric Heitz (JCGT 2014 "Understanding the Masking-Shadowing Function in Microfacet-Based BRDFs") height-correlated Smith joint masking-shadowing function (G2_corr(Lambda_v, Lambda_l) = 1 / (1 + Lambda_v + Lambda_l) = 1 / (1 + 2*Lambda) for symmetric Lambda_v = Lambda_l = Lambda) versus naive uncorrelated separable Smith product (G2_sep = G1(V)*G1(L) = 1 / (1 + Lambda)^2 = 1 / (1 + 2*Lambda + Lambda^2), adding a spurious +Lambda^2 double-occlusion term) and 64-slab microfacet height-CDF quantile integration across 17 invisible-area stations (Lambda in [0.0000, 2.0000]).
